title: DP-MemView: A Memory Interface for Attribute-Level Transcript Privacy in Long-Term LLM Agents
title_zh: DP-MemView：面向长期 LLM Agent 属性级对话隐私的记忆接口
abstract_en: Long-term memory enables persistent personalization in LLM agents, but repeated memory-conditioned responses can cumulatively reveal protected attributes even when they are never stated explicitly. We formalize this threat as adaptive transcript privacy and introduce DP-MemView, a differentially private interface that privately selects public response-conditioning views and exposes those views---rather than raw memory---to the response LLM. Each private selection is charged to every protected attribute whose memory group intersects the read set. Per-attribute ledgers block any selection that would exceed its cap and return a fixed generic view instead. Under an explicit interface contract, we prove pure B_a-DP for the entire adaptive transcript. We also extend the result to stores that differ across multiple protected groups and bound how much observing the transcript can change an adversary's prior odds. We evaluate the online and preallocated modes with three response LLMs on a controlled adjacent-store benchmark and a public-corpus transfer track. Both modes keep transcript distinguishability near chance while preserving target-required personalization and overall response quality. Further diagnostics show that removing key safeguards causes mismatched output support, missing ledger charges, revealing side channels, or growing long-horizon leakage.
abstract_zh: 长期记忆让 LLM Agent 能持续提供个性化体验，但在多轮基于记忆的回复中，即使从未直接陈述受保护属性，模型输出也可能逐步泄露这些属性。本文将该威胁形式化为自适应 transcript privacy，并提出 DP-MemView：一种差分隐私记忆接口。它不把原始记忆暴露给 response LLM，而是私密选择用于生成回复的公共条件化视图（public response-conditioning views）。每次私有选择都会向所有与读取集合相交的受保护属性记忆组计入隐私消耗；若某属性的 per-attribute ledger 超出预算上限，则阻止该选择并返回固定 generic view。在明确的接口契约下，作者证明了整个自适应 transcript 满足纯 B_a-DP，并将结果扩展到多个受保护组同时变化的记忆库场景，同时界定观察 transcript 对攻击者先验 odds 的影响。实验在受控 adjacent-store benchmark 与 public-corpus transfer track 上，使用三个 response LLM 评估 online 与 preallocated 两种模式。结果显示，两种模式都能将 transcript 可区分性维持在接近随机猜测，同时保留目标任务所需的个性化和整体回复质量。消融诊断进一步表明，移除关键保护会导致输出支持不匹配、ledger 漏计、侧信道泄露或长期交互中的泄露增长。
key_points_zh: 提出 adaptive transcript privacy，刻画长期 LLM Agent 在反复基于记忆回复时对受保护属性的累积泄露风险。
设计 DP-MemView：通过差分隐私机制选择公共 conditioning view，而非直接向 response LLM 暴露 raw memory。
引入 per-attribute ledger：按受保护属性记账，超预算时返回固定 generic view，从机制层面限制长期泄露。
理论上证明在接口契约成立时，完整自适应 transcript 满足纯 B_a-DP，并扩展到多个受保护记忆组差异的情形。
实验显示 online 与 preallocated 模式在三个 response LLM 上均能保持接近随机的属性可区分性，同时维持个性化与回复质量。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong agent-runtime privacy work that formalizes and enforces long-horizon memory access control through a reusable differentially private interface.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项较强的智能体运行时隐私工作，通过可复用的差分隐私接口形式化并约束长期记忆访问。
